summary.prose: Building this fix is mostly store work: a new carry table and an in-transaction conditional write in the document-summary store, a carry option on the repository delete, and a reordered full index that marks the repository unfinished before deleting and writes the carried summaries back before it finishes. A one-line guard in the summariser keeps a good summary from being replaced by an error placeholder, and a daemon IPC method restores the lost summaries from the 2026-10-16 backup. The last task ships it to the installed daemon and records the restore and a reindex as smoke evidence.

tasks.title: Store: doc_summary_carry, the in-transaction conditional write and the carry write-back
tasks.summary: Add the docSummaryCarry field to GraphStore and open doc_summary_carry beside doc_summary (src/db/graph/store.ts:301, :624-625), key repoId u32 BE || UTF-8 entity id, value encodeDocSummary. In src/db/doc-summaries.ts factor writeDocSummaryIfCurrent's body into writeDocSummaryIfCurrentInTxn(s, entityId, summary, { onlyIfAbsent?, keepGoodSummary? }) taking the repo id from the stored entity row; declare the two public overloads so the no-options call keeps Promise<DocSummaryWriteOutcome>; add restoreCarriedDocSummaries(repo), which writes back the repository's carry rows in batches of 500 per write transaction, removing each carry row in the same transaction as its outcome.
acceptanceChecks: A store opened from an existing v5 file gains an empty doc_summary_carry and SCHEMA_VERSION stays 5.
writeDocSummaryIfCurrent without options returns exactly 'written' | 'entity-gone' | 'body-changed' as before (existing tests unchanged).
onlyIfAbsent leaves a stored summary in place ('already-present'); keepGoodSummary leaves a stored summary with no errorCode and the same contentHash in place ('kept-good').

restoreCarriedDocSummaries writes a carried summary whose document body still hashes to its contentHash under the document's current entity number, counts entity-gone and body-changed rows, and leaves no carry row for the repository.

tasks.title: deleteEntitiesForRepo carries summaries, or clears the carry
tasks.summary: Add opts.carryDocSummaries to deleteEntitiesForRepo (src/db/entities.ts:567-602): when true, copy every doc_summary row of the repository's entities into doc_summary_carry inside the detachDeleteEntities before hook (the delete's own transaction), combined with the existing returnIncomingToPending hook; when absent, delete the repository's carry rows in a write transaction of deleteEntitiesForRepo's own that runs even with no entities. Return { returnedToPending, carriedDocSummaries } and update the two exact-result assertions in src/db/__tests__/entities-return-to-pending.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: With the option, every summary the delete removes is in doc_summary_carry under (repoId, entity id) after it commits, and carriedDocSummaries equals their number.
With a carry row already present for an id that also has a doc_summary row, the delete with carryDocSummaries leaves the doc_summary value in the carry; a carry row with no live summary is kept.
A failure inside the delete transaction leaves the entities, the summaries and the carry as they were.
Without the option the repository has no carry rows afterwards, also when it has no entities left.
entities-return-to-pending.test.ts passes with carriedDocSummaries: 0 in both expectations.

tasks.title: fullIndex: mark unfinished before the delete, carry, write back
tasks.summary: Add markFullIndexUnfinished(repoPath) to src/db/index-state.ts (sets only fullIndexFinished = false via updateState). In fullIndex (src/indexer/index.ts:612-617) call it before deleteEntitiesForRepo, pass carryDocSummaries: true, add a test seam on IndexerService called right after the delete (like _settlePassesDoneForTest), call restoreCarriedDocSummaries(repoPath) after reconcileRepo and before finishFullIndexState (src/indexer/index.ts:724), log its counts, and correct the comment that says summaries are regenerated.
acceptanceChecks: A reindex keeps the summary of an unchanged document under its new entity number and drops the summaries of a changed and a deleted document.
After a reindex no doc_summary row is keyed by an entity number that is not stored, and doc_summary_by_repo has exactly one entry per stored summary.

A full index of a previously complete repository made to throw immediately after the delete leaves fullIndexFinished false; start-up queues a full index, and that index writes the carried summaries back.
A full index made to throw late (reconcileRepo) keeps the carry, and the next full index writes it back.
After a reindex the doc-summarise-repo sweep makes no model call for a document whose kept summary is current.

tasks.title: Backup restore: restoreDocSummariesFromBackup and the docSummary.restoreFromBackup IPC
tasks.summary: Add restoreDocSummariesFromBackup(backupPath) beside the store code: open the backup as a separate read-only lmdb environment (noSubdir), check doc_summary and entity_string_by_u64 exist, walk doc_summary, map each u64 to its string id, decode the value (undecodable on failure), and write through writeDocSummaryIfCurrentInTxn with onlyIfAbsent in batches of 500 per write transaction; close the backup environment in a finally. Register 'docSummary.restoreFromBackup' in the daemon handler map (src/daemon/index.ts, beside repo.reindex at :839) validating backupPath (absolute, a regular file, not the live store's path from getGraphStorePath) before opening anything; return the six counts.
acceptanceChecks: From a test-built backup, restore writes a summary whose document is stored with the same body by either model, and counts already-present, entity-gone, body-changed and undecodable rows.
A second restore writes nothing and the backup file's bytes are unchanged.
A restore whose backup lacks entity_string_by_u64 rejects, writes nothing and leaves the backup environment closed (a second open of the file succeeds).
The IPC call restores over a seeded daemon and rejects a relative path, a missing file and the live store path without writing.
